questions.q: The price of petrol is increased by $30\%$ then a man can purchase 9 lt. less petrol for $\text{Rs. } 780$. Find Original Purchase, Present Purchase, Original Rate, Present Rate
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, budget $780$ constant hai, seedha fractional jump lagana hai. Jab kharcha same ho toh price aur consumption ulte chalte hain. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Price me vridhi hui $30\%$ yani $+\frac{3}{10}$. Toh consumption me kami aayegi $-\frac{3}{13}$ ki. Question kehta hai 9 liter kam kharida. Yani $3$ unit = 9 liter, toh $1$ unit = 3 liter. Original consumption base (13 unit) thi: $13 \times 3 = 39$ Ltr. Present consumption 3 unit kam hui, yani $10 \times 3 = 30$ Ltr. Ab rate nikal le: Original Rate = $780 / 39 = 20$ Rs/Ltr. Present Rate = $780 / 30 = 26$ Rs/Ltr. Combo ban gaya: 39, 30, 20, 26. Option D tick maar! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ek aur shortcut dekh. Agar budget wahi rakhna hai par petrol 30% mehenga ho gaya, toh $780$ ka $30\%$ yani $234$ rupay extra chahiye the. Usne nahi diye, isliye petrol pump wale ne $9$ liter petrol kam diya. Yani nayi keemat hai $234 / 9 = 26$ Rs/L. Agar naya rate $26$ hai (jo ki original ka $130\%$ hai), toh original = $26 / 1.3 = 20$ Rs/L. Dono rate nikal gaye, quantity nikalna baccho ka khel hai. Exam Takeaway: CPR fraction fraction kheliyo aisi jagah pe. $+\frac{x}{y} \implies -\frac{x}{x+y}$ hamesha kaam aayega.
StepCalculation
1. Naya Rate$30\%$ of 780 = $234 / 9 = 26 \text{ Rs/L}$
2. Purana Rate$26 / 1.3 = 20 \text{ Rs/L}$
3. Original Qty$780 / 20 = 39 \text{ L}$

questions.q: Kavita buys 2 apples and 5 mangoes for 239. When the cost of an apple is decreased by $50\%$ and that of a mango remains the same, then the cost of 2 apples and 4 mangoes is 184. What is the original cost of 8 apples and 8 mangoes?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling (Linear Equations Shift)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, condition shift hone ke baad Apple ka cost aadha ho raha hai. Seedha substitution laga kar equations ko minus karke multiple variables gayab ho jayenge.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehli condition ke samne dusri set kar. Coefficient same kar aur subtract maar.

Mathematically :-
$$ 2A + 5M = 239 \\ (Eq 1) \\\\ 1A + 4M = 184 \\implies 2A + 8M = 368 \\ (Eq 2) \\\\ Eq 2 - Eq 1 \\implies 3M = 129 \\implies M = 43 \\\\ 2A + 5(43) = 239 \\implies A = 12 \\\\ 8(A+M) = 8(12+43) = 8(55) = 440 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Normal bachon ki tarah substitute kar ke bracket solve kar.

Mathematically :-
$$ A = 184 - 4M \\\\ 2(184 - 4M) + 5M = 239 \\\\ 368 - 8M + 5M = 239 \\\\ 3M = 129 \\implies M = 43 \\\\ A = 12 \\implies 8A + 8M = 440 $$

Exam Takeaway: System of equations type ke cost-price sawalo me hamesha coefficient same karke udana best approach hoti hai, special trick of multiples of 11 check karne ke baad.

questions.q: A metallurgist mixes two alloys, A and B, to make a total of 80 kg of a new mixture. Alloy A contains 15% copper, and Alloy B contains 25% copper. If the final mixture contains a total of 15 kg of copper, what is the difference in the weights of Alloy A and Alloy B used?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, mixture dekh ke Alligation yaad aata hai, lekin JSM yahan zyada tez hai kyunki total quantity pata hai. Minimum 15% copper toh dono me hai na!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Base copper 15% maan le. 80kg ka 15% = 12kg. Lekin question bola total 15kg copper hai. Extra kitna? 3kg. Ye extra aya kahan se? Alloy B ke extra 10% (25-15) se. Toh B ka 10% = 3kg $\implies$ B = 30kg. A bacha 50kg. Difference 20kg.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Base} = 15\%$
$\text{Assumed} = 80 \times 0.15 = 12$
$\text{Actual} = 15$
$\text{Extra} = 3$
$10\% \text{ of } B = 3 \implies B = 30$
$A = 50$
$\text{Diff} = 20$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Alligation se karega toh pehle final mixture ka overall percentage nikal, fraction aayega, usme alligate karega toh time lag jayega.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Total Cu } \% = \frac{15}{80} \times 100 = 18.75\%$
$\text{Ratio A:B} = (25 - 18.75) : (18.75 - 15) = 6.25 : 3.75 = 5:3$
$A = 50, B = 30$
$A - B = 20$

Exam Takeaway: Jab bhi do alag percentages ho aur unka overall total number me diya ho, hamesha JSM thok dena, alligation se fast hai.

questions.q: The income of Amala is 20% more than that of Bimala and 20% less than that of Kamala. If Kamala's income goes down by 4% and Bimala's goes up by 10%, then the percentage by which Kamala's income would exceed Bimala's is nearest to
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: Unitary Scaling / Ratio Equalization

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Amala (A) common link hai. A aur B ka relation diya hai, fir A aur C (Kamala) ka. A ko barabar karne ke liye LCM lekar starting base fix kar, aage ki percentages smooth ho jayengi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... A:B = 120:100 = 6:5. A:C = 80:100 = 4:5. A ko common kar (6 aur 4 ka LCM 12 hai). Ratio A:B:C = 12:10:15. Zero laga kar 120, 100, 150 kar le calculation aasan hogi. Ab C ko 4% down kar toh $150 - 6 = 144$. B ko 10% up kar toh $100 + 10 = 110$. Kamala Bimala ko kitne se exceed kar rhi hai? $144 - 110 = 34$. Percentage = $\frac{34}{110} \times 100 = \frac{340}{11} \approx 30.9\%$. Nearest 31%.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Direct fractions se ratio set karna, same logic. Agar variables loge (Let C = x) toh time waste hoga.

Future Exam Takeaway: 3 party relative percentage me hamesha 'Common Link' ka LCM le kar standard 100/1000 ki series banalo.

questions.q: The number of students in A is (y + 63) which is 47 less than that of B. If the number of boys in B is $\frac{1}{3}$ of the total number of students in B and the number of girls in B is $75\%$ of the total number of students in A, then find the total number of students in B?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling / Cross-Product Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan 'y' wali line ekdum bekaar hai, bas time khane ko di hai. Focus sirf A aur B ke relation aur fractions par rakh. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehli line ka saar hai $A = B - 47$. Ab equation banate hain: B me boys $1/3$ hain, toh seedhi baat hai girls $2/3$ hongi. B ki girls $75\%$ (yani $3/4$) of A ke barabar hain. Equation bani: $\frac{2}{3}B = \frac{3}{4}A$. Hamein pata hai $A = B - 47$. Substitute kar de: $\frac{2}{3}B = \frac{3}{4}(B - 47)$. Cross multiply mar de: $8B = 9B - 9 \times 47$. Toh sidha $B = 423$ aayega. Aur yahi pucha hai. Khatam! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar fractions uljhane wale lagein toh ratio likh lo. $B_{girls} : B_{total} = 2 : 3$. And $B_{girls} : A_{total} = 3 : 4$. Dono me $B_{girls}$ ko equate karke ratios mila lo. 2 aur 3 ka LCM 6 banao. Toh $B = 9$, $A = 8$. Difference 1 unit = 47. B chahiye toh $9 \times 47 = 423$. Exam Takeaway: Variables dekh kar confuse mat ho. Unhe ratio me ghuma do.
EntityRatio Form

Total A8 units

questions.q: The price of rice falls by $35\%$. How much extra quantity of rice can be bought with the money that was sufficient to buy 104 kg of rice previously?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab paisa jeb me utna hi ho (amount constant) toh Price aur Consumption hamesha ulte chalte hain, inversely proportional!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): CPR ka jaadu dekh. Price $35\%$ gira yani $100$ se $65$ hua. Ratio bana $20:13$. Toh Quantity ka ratio seedha ulta maro, $13:20$. Pehle $13$ unit aata tha, ab $20$ unit aayega. Purani quantity sawal me $104$ kg di hai. Yani $13$ unit $= 104$ kg $\implies 1$ unit $= 8$ kg. Pucha hai extra kitna aayega? Extra hai $7$ unit. Toh $7 \times 8 = 56$ kg. Bina mehnat ke done.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formula lagao: Extra Quantity $= \frac{x}{100-x} \times \text{Old Quantity}$. Yani $\frac{35}{65} \times 104$. Kat-pit machao, $\frac{7}{13} \times 104 = 7 \times 8 = 56$ kg. Ye direct ratta fication wala method hai.

Exam Takeaway: CPR master kar liya toh Arithmetic me aadhe questions bina pen ke uda doge!

questions.q: A person has to pay 20% tax on the first Rs. 9,000 earned, for the amount earned between Rs. 9,000 and Rs. 15,000 the tax is 25%, and for the amount earned more than Rs. 15,000 the tax is 30%. If he paid 23.33% of his income as tax, then what is his income?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Unitary Scaling

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Overall average tax 23.33\\% (yaani $\\frac{7}{30}$) hai. Pehle 9,000 par 20\\%, agle 6,000 par 25\\%, aur 15,000 se upar bachi hui income $x$ par 30\\% tax lag raha hai. Total income $(15000 + x)$ ho jayegi.

Method 1 (PDF Solution - Remaining Income 'x' Method): Dekh bhai, Tutor ne board par PDF me exact aise hi lagaya hai:
Pehle 9,000 par tax = 20\\% of 9000 = 1800
Agle 6,000 par tax = 25\\% of 6000 = 1500
15,000 se upar bachi income = $x$, ispar tax = 30\\% of $x$

Total Tax = $1800 + 1500 + 30\\% \\text{ of } x$
Ye total tax poori income $(15000 + x)$ ka 23.33\\% (yaani $\\frac{7}{30}$) hai.

Equation set kar:
$$ 1800 + 1500 + \\frac{30}{100}x = \\frac{7}{30}(15000 + x) $$
$$ 3300 + \\frac{3x}{10} = \\frac{7}{30} \\times 15000 + \\frac{7x}{30} $$
$$ 3300 + \\frac{3x}{10} = 3500 + \\frac{7x}{30} $$
$$ \\frac{3x}{10} - \\frac{7x}{30} = 3500 - 3300 $$
$$ \\frac{9x - 7x}{30} = 200 $$
$$ \\frac{2x}{30} = 200 $$
$$ x = 3000 $$

Bacha hua amount $x = 3000$ aaya.
Toh Total Income = $15000 + x = 15000 + 3000 = 18000$.

Method 2 (PDF Solution - Double Alligation / JSM):
Step 1: First 9k @ 20\\%, Next 6k @ 25\\%. Ratio = 3 : 2.
Weighted average tax = $20\\% + \\frac{2 \\times 5\\%}{5} = 22\\%$.

Step 2: Ab Alligation lagao (Rs. 15000 @ 22\\% and Rs. $x$ @ 30\\% to get 23.33\\% = $\\frac{70}{3}\\%$):
Alligation ratio of values:
$$ (30 - \\frac{70}{3}) : (\\frac{70}{3} - 22) $$
$$ \\frac{20}{3} : \\frac{4}{3} = 5 : 1 $$
Agar 5 units = 15,000 hai, toh 1 unit ($x$) = 3,000.
Total Income = $15000 + 3000 = 18000$.

Method 3 (Test App Approach - Options Verification / Ninja Hack): Option A (18,000) check karo.
Slabs: $9000 + 6000 + 3000$
Tax = $1800 + 1500 + 900 = 4200$
$$\\frac{4200}{18000} = \\frac{7}{30} = 23.33\\%$$
Direct match in 10 seconds!

Best Exam Takeaway: Tutor ka $x$ wala linear equation basic setup ke liye mast hai, lekin exam me Options Substitution se solve karoge toh bina kisi calculation mistake ke 15 sec me question phod doge!

questions.q: If due to a 12% decrease in the price of sugar, Akshat can buy 7 kg more sugar for Rs. 1200, then find the actual price (in rs) of sugar?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ye basic savings model hai. ₹1200 ka $12\%$ pocket me bacha, jis se 7 kg chini mili. Seedha naya price aagaya. Naya price purane ka $88\%$ hai. Boom!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Naya price nikal ke actual ke liye reverse factor ka multiply.

Mathematically :-
$$New \ Price = \frac{1200 \times 0.12}{7} = \frac{144}{7} \\\\ Old \ Price \times 0.88 = \frac{144}{7} \\\\ Old \ Price = \frac{144}{7 \times 0.88} = \frac{14400}{7 \times 88} \\\\ = \frac{1800}{77} \approx 23.376... \approx 23.38$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Total Quantity ka equation equate kar ke base form me solve karo.

Mathematically :-
$$P \times Q = 1200 \\\\ 0.88P \times (Q + 7) = 1200 \\\\ 0.88P (\frac{1200}{P} + 7) = 1200 \\\\ 1056 + 6.16P = 1200 \\\\ 6.16P = 144 \Rightarrow P = \frac{144}{6.16} \approx 23.38$$

Exam Takeaway: Concept fix kar lo - reduced price nikalna bohot fast hai, uske baad actual price reverse percentage se nikalo.

questions.s:
[Core Tool Triggered: Unitary Scaling]

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Ek litre par hike $= 8\%$ of $150 = 12 \text{ Rs}$.

questions.q: In an examination a candidate had to sit for three papers A, B, and C. The candidate secured $70\%$ marks in Paper A, $80\%$ marks in Paper B, and $50\%$ marks in Paper C. If the weightage assigned to Papers A, B, and C were $30\%$, $60\%$ and $20\%$, respectively, then find the weighted percentage of marks obtained by the candidate, when all the three papers were taken together?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, options $70\%$ ke aaspas ghoom rahe hain. Weightage ratio $3:6:2$ hai. Paper B ($80\%$) ka wazan sabse jyada hai, toh average pakka $70$ se upar khiskega aur $80$ ki taraf inclined hoga.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Weightage ka ratio bana le $3:6:2$. Base average $70\%$ maan le. A pe deviation $0$, B par deviation $+10\%$ hai ($6$ weight pe = $+60$), C par deviation $-20\%$ hai ($2$ weight pe = $-40$). Net deviation $+20$ aaya. Isko total weight $11$ me baant de. Khatam!

Mathematically :-
$$ Base = 70\\% \\\\ Dev_A = 3 \\times 0 = 0 \\\\ Dev_B = 6 \\times (+10) = +60 \\\\ Dev_C = 2 \\times (-20) = -40 \\\\ Net \\ Dev = +20 \\\\ Avg = 70 + \\frac{20}{11} = 71.81\\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic weighted average laga. Pura divide mat kar, $11 \times 71$ hota hai $781$, uske thoda aage $71.81$ dikh raha hai.

Mathematically :-
$$ \\frac{3 \\times 70 + 6 \\times 80 + 2 \\times 50}{3+6+2} \\\\ = \\frac{210 + 480 + 100}{11} \\\\ = \\frac{790}{11} = 71.81\\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Hamesha percentages ya weights ko chote ratio me kaat liya kar, calculation aadhi ho jayegi aur time bachega!

questions.q: A fraction is reduced such that when it is squared and then its numerator is increased by $20\%$ and denominator is reduced by $25\%$, it results in $\frac{6}{5}$ of the original fraction. The product of the numerator and denominator is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fraction change ko seedha multiplier me likh aur equation ko direct kaat, variable $F$ apne aap bahar aayegi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Direct decimal fraction. Mathematically :-
$$F^2 \times \frac{1.20}{0.75} = \frac{6}{5} F$$
$$F = \frac{6}{5} \times \frac{75}{120} = \frac{3}{4}$$
$$N \times D = 3 \times 4 = 12$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractional split method. Mathematically :-
$$F^2 \times \frac{\frac{6}{5}}{\frac{3}{4}} = \frac{6}{5} F$$
$$F^2 \times \frac{24}{15} = \frac{6}{5} F$$
$$F = \frac{6}{5} \times \frac{15}{24} = \frac{3}{4}$$
$$N \times D = 12$$

Exam Takeaway: Decimal multipliers use kar, values turant fraction form me cancel out hogi.

questions.q: When (A + 10)% of a number is added to 180, the result is the same number. If 120% of the original number is 540, then find (A - 26)% of the original number.
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, thoda reverse statement diya hai. Jab kisi hisse me ek number jodte hain aur original wapas aa jaye, toh wo joda hua number baaki bacha hua percentage hi hota hai. Statements ulta solve karna best hai.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Pehle original number nikalte hain. $1.2N = 540 \implies N = 450$. Ab condition padh: $(A+10)\%$ hisse me 180 joda toh fir se pura 450 ban gaya. Matlab $450 - 180 = 270$. Ye 270 us number (450) ka kitna part hai? $\frac{270}{450} = \frac{3}{5} = 60\%$. Toh $(A+10) = 60 \implies A = 50$. Pucha kya hai? $(A-26)\%, yani (50-26)\% = 24\%$ nikalna hai 450 ka. $450 \times 0.24 = 108$. Mind math lagayega toh jaldi aayega!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Concept ye kehta hai ki pura number = 100\%. Toh baaki percentage $100 - (A+10)$ = 180 hoga. Wahan se tu seedha $180 / 450$ karega toh $40\%$ aayega. Yani $100 - (A+10) = 40 \implies A = 50$.

**Exam Takeaway:** Equations banate time base fractions ko side-by-side compare kar liya karo. CGL me "reverse loop" wale questions common hain.

StepCalculation
A. Finding Number (N)1. $540 \div 1.2 = 450$
B. Percentage Part assigned2. $\frac{270}{450} = 60\% \implies A = 50$

questions.q: The strength of a school increases and decreases every alternate year by $15\%$. If it started with an increase in 2012, then the strength of the school in the beginning of 2015, as compared to that in 2012, had (correct to two decimal places):
questions.s:
[Core Tool Triggered: Successive Change]

Pen-Free Observation: 2012 se 2015 tak 3 transitions hain: $+15\%, -15\%, +15\%$. Pehle do ka net seedha $-x^2/100$ hota hai, uske baad teesre ko combine karna hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
1st & 2nd year effect: $+15\%$ aur $-15\% \Rightarrow \frac{-15^2}{100} = -2.25\%$.
Ab is $-2.25\%$ ka $+15\%$ ke sath successive laga de ($x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$):
$-2.25 + 15 + \frac{(-2.25 \times 15)}{100}$
$= 12.75 - 0.3375 = +12.4125\%$.
Yani positive value aayi hai, matlab $12.41\%$ ka increase hua.

Takeaway: 3 successive percentages nikalne ke liye hamesha 2-2 ke jode banakar solve karo.

Find the total number of voters in the village, if (x/2)% of the total number of votes is 1200.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: Cross-Product Method / Unitary Scaling

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Ratio 3:2 dekhte hi dimag me aana chahiye ki inka gap 1 unit ka hai. Percent me gap x aur (x-20) ka 20% hai. 1 unit = 20%!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, question me hi answer chhipa hai. Gap ratio me 1 unit hai, aur percent me 20. Toh A ka vote 3 unit = 60%, B ka vote 2 unit = 40%. Direct mil gaya x = 60. Ab diya hai $(x/2)\%$ of Total = 1200. Matlab $30\%$ of Total = 1200. Toh $10\% = 400$, and $100\% = 4000$. Pen chhoone ki saza-e-maut hai is question me!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equation banayega: $\frac{x}{x-20} = \frac{3}{2}$. Cross multiply: $2x = 3x - 60 \implies x = 60$. Fir wahi same steps.

Future Exam Takeaway: Ratio scaling is king. Jab relative gap percentage me diya ho, direct ratio parts se equate kar de.

questions.q: In an election for college president held in a college, the voting percentage was 83.33%. The winner got 33.33% of the polled votes, while the runner-up got 22.22% of the polled votes. If there were 216108 voters in the university, by how many votes did the winner win the election?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sab kuch standard fractions hai. Base Total hai. Polled nikalo $5/6$ karke, fir polled ka win gap direct minus karke nikalo. Beech me koi step solve mat karna warna time kharab hoga.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Sab fraction me likh kar margin ko final equation se ek jhatke me udhao.

Mathematically :-
$$Total = 216108 \\\\ Polled = 216108 \times \frac{5}{6} = 180090 \\\\ Margin = (\frac{1}{3} - \frac{2}{9}) \ of \ Polled \\\\ Margin = (\frac{3}{9} - \frac{2}{9}) = \frac{1}{9} \\\\ Win \ Votes = 180090 \times \frac{1}{9} = 20010$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Polled nikal kar, fir Winner, fir Loser ke votes alag se nikalna.

Mathematically :-
$$Polled = 216108 \times \frac{5}{6} = 180090 \\\\ Winner = 180090 \times \frac{1}{3} = 60030 \\\\ Loser = 180090 \times \frac{2}{9} = 40020 \\\\ Difference = 60030 - 40020 = 20010$$

Exam Takeaway: Election questions me 'Polled' aur 'Total' ka farak jaan lena zaroori hai. Har stage pe multiply karne se bacho, final cut ek sath karo.

questions.q: In a city, 12% of households earn less than Rs. 30,000 per year, 6% households earn more than Rs. 2,00,000 per year, 22% households earn more than Rs. 1,00,000 per year and 990 households earn between Rs. 30,000 and Rs. 1,00,000 per year. How many households earn between Rs. 1,00,000 and Rs. 2,00,000 per year?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, income groups ke brackets banaye gaye hain. Sab percentages ko timeline par set kar de ekdam clear dikhega. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total population 100% hai. <30k wale hue $12\%$. >100k wale hue $22\%$. Inke beech (yani 30k se 100k ke beech) wale kitne bache? $100\% - (12\% + 22\%) = 66\%$. Ye 66% $990$ households ke barabar de rakha hai. Yani $1\% = \frac{990}{66} = 15$. Ab hamein kya nikalna hai? 100k se 200k ke beech wale. >100k total $22\%$ hain, jisme se >200k wale $6\%$ pehle hi hain. Toh bracket me aaye: $22\% - 6\% = 16\%$. Seedha answer: $16 \times 15 = 240$ households. Ek line ka question tha, language fasa rahi thi! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Range set kar le: A(<30k), B(30-100k), C(100-200k), D(>200k). Given: A = 12%. C + D = 22%. D = 6%. Isliye C = 16%. Total = A + B + C + D = 100%. B = 100% - 12% - 22% = 66%. B = 990. Baki equate karna upar bata hi diya hai. questions.q: If first number is $8\frac{1}{3}\%$ less than third number and ratio of second and third number is 15:16 then average of first and third number is how much percent less/more than second number?

Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $8\frac{1}{3}\%$ hota hai $1/12$. Matlab 1st aur 3rd ka ratio 11:12 hai. Udhar 2nd aur 3rd ka 15:16 hai. Third number ko equal kar, sab sort ho jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): 12 aur 16 ka LCM 48 hota hai. 3rd ko 48 banayega toh 1st = 44, 2nd = 45 aayega. 1st aur 3rd ka average = 46. 46, 45 se 1 zyada hai 45 pe. $1/45$ seedha $2.22\%$ deta hai.

Mathematically :-
$I:III = 11:12 = 44:48$
$II:III = 15:16 = 45:48$
$\text{Avg}(I, III) = 46$
$\text{Diff} = 46 - 45 = 1$
$\% = \frac{1}{45} \times 100 = 2.22\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ratio balancing aani chahiye. $A:C = 11:12$ aur $B:C = 15:16$. C common hai, toh usey same bana. Fir simply percentage change nikal de naye base B par.

Mathematically :-
$C = 48$
$A = 44$
$B = 45$
$\frac{44+48}{2} = 46$
$\frac{46-45}{45} \times 100 = 2.22\%$

Pucha hai 80, 70 se kitna zyada hai? 10 zyada hai base 70 pe. $\frac{10}{70} = \frac{1}{7} = 14.28\%$. Bawal! questions.q: A solution of sugar and milk contains 26% sugar by weight. After boiling, 63 kg milk evaporates and the solution now contains 40% of sugar. Find the original quantity of solution?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, boil karne par hamesha paani ya doodh hi udata hai, cheeni wahi ki wahi rehti hai. Jo solid part hai wo humesha constant rahega. Bas yahi dimaag laga kar single equation banani hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Jo cheez constant hai (sugar) usko dono taraf equate kar aur ratio nikal le!

Mathematically :-
$$26\% \times O = 40\% \times N$$
$$O:N = 40:26 = 20:13$$
$$\text{Evaporated} = 7u = 63 \implies 1u = 9$$
$$\text{Original} = 20u = 20 \times 9 = 180 \text{ kg}$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic equation method jisme initial quantity ko $x$ maan kar solve karte hain.

Mathematically :-
$$0.26x = 0.40(x - 63)$$
$$0.26x = 0.40x - 25.2$$
$$0.14x = 25.2 \implies x = 180 \text{ kg}$$

Exam Takeaway: Mixture ke sawalo me jo cheez evaporate nahi hoti ya add nahi hoti, hamesha wahi constant hoti hai aur usi ko equate kiya kar!

questions.q: Due to an increase of $32\%$ in the price of pulse, a person reduces his consumption in such a way that his expenditure increases only by $10\%$. If he consumes 150 kg of pulse after the price has increased, then how much pulse was consumed by him initially?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Constant Product Ratio (CPR) ki ninja trick laga, Initial aur Final consumption ka seedha fraction nikal.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): CPR direct fraction. Mathematically :-
$$\frac{Initial}{Final} = \frac{100 + P\%}{100 + E\%} = \frac{132}{110} = \frac{6}{5}$$
$$5 \rightarrow 150 \Rightarrow 1 \rightarrow 30$$
$$6 \rightarrow 180$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Traditional formula. Mathematically :-
$$P_{new} = 1.32 P_{old}$$
$$E_{new} = 1.10 E_{old}$$
$$C_{new} = \frac{E_{new}}{P_{new}} = \frac{1.10}{1.32} C_{old} = \frac{5}{6} C_{old}$$
$$\frac{5}{6} C_{old} = 150 \Rightarrow C_{old} = 180$$

Exam Takeaway: Price aur Expenditure ke percentages diye hon toh formula me base swap karke consumption ka ratio instantly ban jata hai.

Ratio Direct HackC1 / C2 = (100 + E2\%) / (100 + P2\%) doesn't hold. Right hack is Initial/Final = (100+New Price) / (100+New Exp).

$$ 2A + 5M = 239 \\ (Eq 1) \\\\ 1A + 4M = 184 \\implies 2A + 8M = 368 \\ (Eq 2) \\\\ Eq 2 - Eq 1 \\implies 3M = 129 \\implies M = 43 \\\\ 2A + 5(43) = 239 \\implies A = 12 \\\\ 8(A+M) = 8(12+43) = 8(55) = 440 $$

Mathematically :-
$$ A = 184 - 4M \\\\ 2(184 - 4M) + 5M = 239 \\\\ 368 - 8M + 5M = 239 \\\\ 3M = 129 \\implies M = 43 \\\\ A = 12 \\implies 8A + 8M = 440 $$

questions_hin.q_hi: A person has to pay 20% tax on the first Rs. 9,000 earned, for the amount earned between Rs. 9,000 and Rs. 15,000 the tax is 25%, and for the amount earned more than Rs. 15,000 the tax is 30%. If he paid 23.33% of his income as tax, then what is his income?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Unitary Scaling

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Overall average tax 23.33\\% (yaani $\\frac{7}{30}$) hai. Pehle 9,000 par 20\\%, agle 6,000 par 25\\%, aur 15,000 se upar bachi hui income $x$ par 30\\% tax lag raha hai. Total income $(15000 + x)$ ho jayegi.

Method 1 (PDF Solution - Remaining Income 'x' Method): Dekh bhai, Tutor ne board par PDF me exact aise hi lagaya hai:
Pehle 9,000 par tax = 20\\% of 9000 = 1800
Agle 6,000 par tax = 25\\% of 6000 = 1500
15,000 se upar bachi income = $x$, ispar tax = 30\\% of $x$

Total Tax = $1800 + 1500 + 30\\% \\text{ of } x$
Ye total tax poori income $(15000 + x)$ ka 23.33\\% (yaani $\\frac{7}{30}$) hai.

Equation set kar:
$$ 1800 + 1500 + \\frac{30}{100}x = \\frac{7}{30}(15000 + x) $$
$$ 3300 + \\frac{3x}{10} = \\frac{7}{30} \\times 15000 + \\frac{7x}{30} $$
$$ 3300 + \\frac{3x}{10} = 3500 + \\frac{7x}{30} $$
$$ \\frac{3x}{10} - \\frac{7x}{30} = 3500 - 3300 $$
$$ \\frac{9x - 7x}{30} = 200 $$
$$ \\frac{2x}{30} = 200 $$
$$ x = 3000 $$

Bacha hua amount $x = 3000$ aaya.
Toh Total Income = $15000 + x = 15000 + 3000 = 18000$.

Method 2 (PDF Solution - Double Alligation / JSM):
Step 1: First 9k @ 20\\%, Next 6k @ 25\\%. Ratio = 3 : 2.
Weighted average tax = $20\\% + \\frac{2 \\times 5\\%}{5} = 22\\%$.

Step 2: Ab Alligation lagao (Rs. 15000 @ 22\\% and Rs. $x$ @ 30\\% to get 23.33\\% = $\\frac{70}{3}\\%$):
Alligation ratio of values:
$$ (30 - \\frac{70}{3}) : (\\frac{70}{3} - 22) $$
$$ \\frac{20}{3} : \\frac{4}{3} = 5 : 1 $$
Agar 5 units = 15,000 hai, toh 1 unit ($x$) = 3,000.
Total Income = $15000 + 3000 = 18000$.

Method 3 (Test App Approach - Options Verification / Ninja Hack): Option A (18,000) check karo.
Slabs: $9000 + 6000 + 3000$
Tax = $1800 + 1500 + 900 = 4200$
$$\\frac{4200}{18000} = \\frac{7}{30} = 23.33\\%$$
Direct match in 10 seconds!

Best Exam Takeaway: Tutor ka $x$ wala linear equation basic setup ke liye mast hai, lekin exam me Options Substitution se solve karoge toh bina kisi calculation mistake ke 15 sec me question phod doge!

Core Conceptual Tool: CPR

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ye basic savings model hai. ₹1200 ka $12\%$ pocket me bacha, jis se 7 kg chini mili. Seedha naya price aagaya. Naya price purane ka $88\%$ hai. Boom!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Naya price nikal ke actual ke liye reverse factor ka multiply.

Mathematically :-
$$New \ Price = \frac{1200 \times 0.12}{7} = \frac{144}{7} \\\\ Old \ Price \times 0.88 = \frac{144}{7} \\\\ Old \ Price = \frac{144}{7 \times 0.88} = \frac{14400}{7 \times 88} \\\\ = \frac{1800}{77} \approx 23.376... \approx 23.38$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Total Quantity ka equation equate kar ke base form me solve karo.

Mathematically :-

questions_hin.q_hi: In an examination a candidate had to sit for three papers A, B, and C. The candidate secured $70\%$ marks in Paper A, $80\%$ marks in Paper B, and $50\%$ marks in Paper C. If the weightage assigned to Papers A, B, and C were $30\%$, $60\%$ and $20\%$, respectively, then find the weighted percentage of marks obtained by the candidate, when all the three papers were taken together?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, options $70\%$ ke aaspas ghoom rahe hain. Weightage ratio $3:6:2$ hai. Paper B ($80\%$) ka wazan sabse jyada hai, toh average pakka $70$ se upar khiskega aur $80$ ki taraf inclined hoga.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Weightage ka ratio bana le $3:6:2$. Base average $70\%$ maan le. A pe deviation $0$, B par deviation $+10\%$ hai ($6$ weight pe = $+60$), C par deviation $-20\%$ hai ($2$ weight pe = $-40$). Net deviation $+20$ aaya. Isko total weight $11$ me baant de. Khatam!

Mathematically :-
$$ Base = 70\\% \\\\ Dev_A = 3 \\times 0 = 0 \\\\ Dev_B = 6 \\times (+10) = +60 \\\\ Dev_C = 2 \\times (-20) = -40 \\\\ Net \\ Dev = +20 \\\\ Avg = 70 + \\frac{20}{11} = 71.81\\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic weighted average laga. Pura divide mat kar, $11 \times 71$ hota hai $781$, uske thoda aage $71.81$ dikh raha hai.

Mathematically :-
$$ \\frac{3 \\times 70 + 6 \\times 80 + 2 \\times 50}{3+6+2} \\\\ = \\frac{210 + 480 + 100}{11} \\\\ = \\frac{790}{11} = 71.81\\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Hamesha percentages ya weights ko chote ratio me kaat liya kar, calculation aadhi ho jayegi aur time bachega!

questions_hin.q_hi: When (A + 10)% of a number is added to 180, the result is the same number. If 120% of the original number is 540, then find (A - 26)% of the original number.
questions_hin.s_hi:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, thoda reverse statement diya hai. Jab kisi hisse me ek number jodte hain aur original wapas aa jaye, toh wo joda hua number baaki bacha hua percentage hi hota hai. Statements ulta solve karna best hai.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Pehle original number nikalte hain. $1.2N = 540 \implies N = 450$. Ab condition padh: $(A+10)\%$ hisse me 180 joda toh fir se pura 450 ban gaya. Matlab $450 - 180 = 270$. Ye 270 us number (450) ka kitna part hai? $\frac{270}{450} = \frac{3}{5} = 60\%$. Toh $(A+10) = 60 \implies A = 50$. Pucha kya hai? $(A-26)\%, yani (50-26)\% = 24\%$ nikalna hai 450 ka. $450 \times 0.24 = 108$. Mind math lagayega toh jaldi aayega!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Concept ye kehta hai ki pura number = 100\%. Toh baaki percentage $100 - (A+10)$ = 180 hoga. Wahan se tu seedha $180 / 450$ karega toh $40\%$ aayega. Yani $100 - (A+10) = 40 \implies A = 50$.

**Exam Takeaway:** Equations banate time base fractions ko side-by-side compare kar liya karo. CGL me "reverse loop" wale questions common hain.

questions_hin.s_hi:
[Core Tool Triggered: Successive Change]

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):

Ab is $-2.25\%$ ka $+15\%$ ke sath successive laga de ($x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$):
$-2.25 + 15 + \frac{(-2.25 \times 15)}{100}$
$= 12.75 - 0.3375 = +12.4125\%$.

questions_hin.q_hi: A and B contested in an election in a village. A got x% of the total number of votes and B got (x – 20)% of the total number of votes and the ratio of the total number of votes obtained by A to B is 3:2. Find the total number of voters in the village, if (x/2)% of the total number of votes is 1200.

Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: Cross-Product Method / Unitary Scaling

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Ratio 3:2 dekhte hi dimag me aana chahiye ki inka gap 1 unit ka hai. Percent me gap x aur (x-20) ka 20% hai. 1 unit = 20%!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, question me hi answer chhipa hai. Gap ratio me 1 unit hai, aur percent me 20. Toh A ka vote 3 unit = 60%, B ka vote 2 unit = 40%. Direct mil gaya x = 60. Ab diya hai $(x/2)\%$ of Total = 1200. Matlab $30\%$ of Total = 1200. Toh $10\% = 400$, and $100\% = 4000$. Pen chhoone ki saza-e-maut hai is question me!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equation banayega: $\frac{x}{x-20} = \frac{3}{2}$. Cross multiply: $2x = 3x - 60 \implies x = 60$. Fir wahi same steps.

Future Exam Takeaway: Ratio scaling is king. Jab relative gap percentage me diya ho, direct ratio parts se equate kar de.

questions_hin.q_hi: In an election for college president held in a college, the voting percentage was 83.33%. The winner got 33.33% of the polled votes, while the runner-up got 22.22% of the polled votes. If there were 216108 voters in the university, by how many votes did the winner win the election?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sab kuch standard fractions hai. Base Total hai. Polled nikalo $5/6$ karke, fir polled ka win gap direct minus karke nikalo. Beech me koi step solve mat karna warna time kharab hoga.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Sab fraction me likh kar margin ko final equation se ek jhatke me udhao.

Mathematically :-
$$Total = 216108 \\\\ Polled = 216108 \times \frac{5}{6} = 180090 \\\\ Margin = (\frac{1}{3} - \frac{2}{9}) \ of \ Polled \\\\ Margin = (\frac{3}{9} - \frac{2}{9}) = \frac{1}{9} \\\\ Win \ Votes = 180090 \times \frac{1}{9} = 20010$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Polled nikal kar, fir Winner, fir Loser ke votes alag se nikalna.

Mathematically :-
$$Polled = 216108 \times \frac{5}{6} = 180090 \\\\ Winner = 180090 \times \frac{1}{3} = 60030 \\\\ Loser = 180090 \times \frac{2}{9} = 40020 \\\\ Difference = 60030 - 40020 = 20010$$

Exam Takeaway: Election questions me 'Polled' aur 'Total' ka farak jaan lena zaroori hai. Har stage pe multiply karne se bacho, final cut ek sath karo.

Fraction Memory$83.33\% = 5/6$, $22.22\% = 2/9$

questions_hin.q_hi: In a city, 12% of households earn less than Rs. 30,000 per year, 6% households earn more than Rs. 2,00,000 per year, 22% households earn more than Rs. 1,00,000 per year and 990 households earn between Rs. 30,000 and Rs. 1,00,000 per year. How many households earn between Rs. 1,00,000 and Rs. 2,00,000 per year?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, income groups ke brackets banaye gaye hain. Sab percentages ko timeline par set kar de ekdam clear dikhega. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total population 100% hai. <30k wale hue $12\%$. >100k wale hue $22\%$. Inke beech (yani 30k se 100k ke beech) wale kitne bache? $100\% - (12\% + 22\%) = 66\%$. Ye 66% $990$ households ke barabar de rakha hai. Yani $1\% = \frac{990}{66} = 15$. Ab hamein kya nikalna hai? 100k se 200k ke beech wale. >100k total $22\%$ hain, jisme se >200k wale $6\%$ pehle hi hain. Toh bracket me aaye: $22\% - 6\% = 16\%$. Seedha answer: $16 \times 15 = 240$ households. Ek line ka question tha, language fasa rahi thi! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Range set kar le: A(<30k), B(30-100k), C(100-200k), D(>200k). Given: A = 12%. C + D = 22%. D = 6%. Isliye C = 16%. Total = A + B + C + D = 100%. B = 100% - 12% - 22% = 66%. B = 990. Baki equate karna upar bata hi diya hai. questions_hin.q_hi: If first number is $8\frac{1}{3}\%$ less than third number and ratio of second and third number is 15:16 then average of first and third number is how much percent less/more than second number?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $8\frac{1}{3}\%$ hota hai $1/12$. Matlab 1st aur 3rd ka ratio 11:12 hai. Udhar 2nd aur 3rd ka 15:16 hai. Third number ko equal kar, sab sort ho jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): 12 aur 16 ka LCM 48 hota hai. 3rd ko 48 banayega toh 1st = 44, 2nd = 45 aayega. 1st aur 3rd ka average = 46. 46, 45 se 1 zyada hai 45 pe. $1/45$ seedha $2.22\%$ deta hai.

Mathematically :-
$I:III = 11:12 = 44:48$
$II:III = 15:16 = 45:48$
$\text{Avg}(I, III) = 46$
$\text{Diff} = 46 - 45 = 1$
$\% = \frac{1}{45} \times 100 = 2.22\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ratio balancing aani chahiye. $A:C = 11:12$ aur $B:C = 15:16$. C common hai, toh usey same bana. Fir simply percentage change nikal de naye base B par.

Mathematically :-
$C = 48$
$A = 44$
$B = 45$
$\frac{44+48}{2} = 46$
$\frac{46-45}{45} \times 100 = 2.22\%$

Exam Takeaway: Ratio ko merge karne ke liye humesha LCM ka base shift method use kiya kar, x maan ke mat beth jana!

II : III = 15 : 16$45 : 48$

questions_hin.q_hi: If decreasing 80 by $x\%$ gives the same result as increasing 16 by $x\%$, then $x\%$ of 120 is how much percentage more than $33.33\%$ of 210?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, question lamba zaroor hai par basic equation ka hai. 80 aur 16 ke beech 5:1 ka ratio dikhte hi dimaag me fraction aana chahiye. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Equation set kar: $80(1 - \frac{x}{100}) = 16(1 + \frac{x}{100})$. 16 se 80 ko 5 baar kaat. $5 - \frac{5x}{100} = 1 + \frac{x}{100} \implies 4 = \frac{6x}{100} \implies x = 66.66\%$. Ab sawal ka part 2 padh: $66.66\%$ (yani $\frac{2}{3}$) of 120 = 80. Aur dusra part $33.33\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{3}$) of 210 = 70. Pucha hai 80, 70 se kitna zyada hai? 10 zyada hai base 70 pe. $\frac{10}{70} = \frac{1}{7} = 14.28\%$. Bawal! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar $x$ nikalne me time lag raha hai, toh options aur standard fractions $1/7, 1/8$ yaad hone chahiye. $\frac{1}{7}$ direct $14.28\%$ hit karega. questions_hin.q_hi: In a family the ratio of expenditure to the savings was 7: 4. But their expenditure is increased by $42.84\%$ and income increased by only $20\%$ thus there is a deficit of Rs. 6448 in the savings. Find the increase in the income of the family.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $42.84\%$ dekhte hi pet me dard nahi hona chahiye. Ye $14.28\%$ (yani $1/7$) ka exactly 3 guna hai, yani $3/7$.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Maan le Exp $700$ aur Sav $400$ hai. Toh Income ho gayi $1100$. Expenditure $3/7$ badha, yani $700$ par $300$ badha, toh naya Exp $= 1000$. Income $20\%$ badhi yani $1100$ ka $20\%$ $= 220$ badhi, nayi Income $= 1320$. Nayi savings aayi $1320 - 1000 = 320$. Purani savings thi $400$. Kitne ki kami aayi? $80$ units ki! Question kehta hai deficit $6448$ hai. Toh $80$ units $= 6448$. Pucha kya hai? Increase in income yani $220$ units ki value. $\frac{6448}{80} \times 220 = 17732$. Calculations thodi tagdi hain par method solid hai.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Sirf changes par khelega toh: Income change = Exp change + Sav change. Income change $+220$, Exp change $+300$. Toh $+220 = +300 + \Delta S \implies \Delta S = -80$. Deficit $80$ units aaya. Phir wahi relation se answer nikal. Ye zyada smart method hai!

Exam Takeaway: Bade weird percentages kisi na kisi standard fraction ka multiple hote hain, observe the fractions first!

questions_hin.q_hi: In a certain college, each of 240 students can speak at least one language. The total number of Hindi speaking students are $(2x+10)\%$ and the total number of urdu speaking students are $(x+20)\%$. If $(x-10)\%$ of total students can speak both the languages, then find students who speak only urdu is what percent of the students who speak only Hindi.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 240 ka koi kaam nahi hai, ye sirf darane ki ninja technique hai! Seedha saare percentages ko $100\%$ ke barabar rakh de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Union formula lagao aur value nikalo. Mathematically :-
$$100 = (2x+10) + (x+20) - (x-10)$$
$$100 = 2x + 40 \Rightarrow 2x = 60 \Rightarrow x = 30$$
$$Only\_H = 70 - 20 = 50\%$$
$$Only\_U = 50 - 20 = 30\%$$
$$\frac{30}{50} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Detailed Set Theory. Mathematically :-
$$n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$$
$$100\% = (2x+10)\% + (x+20)\% - (x-10)\%$$
$$100 = 2x + 40 \Rightarrow x = 30$$
$$Hindi = 70\%, Urdu = 50\%, Both = 20\%$$
$$\frac{50 - 20}{70 - 20} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Venn diagram banane ki zarurat nahi agar formula dimag me clear ho. Sirf percentage pe khelo.

questions_hin.q_hi: A's salary is 40% more than B's. If B's salary increases by 20% and A's increases by x%, then A's new salary becomes 25% more than B's new salary. What is the value of x?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: Unitary Scaling

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: B ka base 100 maan. 100 -> 120. A naya hoga 120 ka 1.25 times, jo 150 hota hai. A tha 140, ho gaya 150. Jump 10 ka hai 140 par. Option 7.14% turant dikhna chahiye kyuki $\frac{1}{14}$ fraction standard hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... B = 100, A = 140. Naya B = 120. Naya A = $120 \times 1.25 = 150$. A badha 10 se (140 to 150). $x = \frac{10}{140} \times 100$. Zero se zero kaat, $\frac{1}{14}$ bacha. Answer 7.14%.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Multiplier method. A = 1.4 B. Naya B = 1.2 B. Naya A = 1.25 * (1.2 B) = 1.5 B. Pehle A 1.4 B tha, ab 1.5 B hai. Growth = $\frac{0.1}{1.4} = \frac{1}{14}$.

Future Exam Takeaway: Ratio trick se fraction $\frac{1}{14}$ direct yaad hona chahiye, CGL me yahi time bachega!

questions_hin.q_hi: There are 2800 students in a school, out of which $75\%$ participate in a sport competition. Out of those who participate, $60\%$ are boys. $35\%$ of the boys and $25\%$ of the girls qualify for the final round of the competition. What percentage of the school will participate in the final round?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, question padhte hi 2800 ko kaat de dimag me. Percentage pucha hai toh 100 base maan kar fraction me hi rahenge!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total 100 bacche hain. $75$ ne participate kiya. Inme se $60\%$ ladke hain, toh $75$ ka $60\%$ ($3/5$) $= 45$ Boys. Bachi hui $30$ Girls hain. Qualify hone wale: Boys hain $45$ ka $35\%$ $= 15.75$. Girls hain $30$ ka $25\%$ (yani chauthayi) $= 7.5$. Total qualify kitne hue? $15.75 + 7.5 = 23.25$. Ye total 100 ka kitna percent hai? Seedha $23.25\%$ yani $23 \frac{1}{4}\!\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Tree diagram. Participate: $3/4$. Boys: $3/5$ of $3/4 = 9/20$. Girls: $2/5$ of $3/4 = 3/10$. Qualified boys $= 35\%$ of $9/20 = \frac{63}{400}$. Qualified girls $= 25\%$ of $3/10 = \frac{3}{40}$. Total $= \frac{63+30}{400} = \frac{93}{400}$. Percentage nikalo $= \frac{93}{4} = 23.25\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Badi absolute values exam me bas tumhe fasane aur time kill karne ke liye hoti hain.

questions_hin.q_hi: A solution of sugar and milk contains 26% sugar by weight. After boiling, 63 kg milk evaporates and the solution now contains 40% of sugar. Find the original quantity of solution?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, boil karne par hamesha paani ya doodh hi udata hai, cheeni wahi ki wahi rehti hai. Jo solid part hai wo humesha constant rahega. Bas yahi dimaag laga kar single equation banani hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Jo cheez constant hai (sugar) usko dono taraf equate kar aur ratio nikal le!

Mathematically :-
$$26\% \times O = 40\% \times N$$
$$O:N = 40:26 = 20:13$$
$$\text{Evaporated} = 7u = 63 \implies 1u = 9$$
$$\text{Original} = 20u = 20 \times 9 = 180 \text{ kg}$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic equation method jisme initial quantity ko $x$ maan kar solve karte hain.

Mathematically :-
$$0.26x = 0.40(x - 63)$$
$$0.26x = 0.40x - 25.2$$
$$0.14x = 25.2 \implies x = 180 \text{ kg}$$

Exam Takeaway: Mixture ke sawalo me jo cheez evaporate nahi hoti ya add nahi hoti, hamesha wahi constant hoti hai aur usi ko equate kiya kar!

Solid Constancy$P_1 \times Q_1 = P_2 \times Q_2$

questions_hin.q_hi: Due to an increase of $32\%$ in the price of pulse, a person reduces his consumption in such a way that his expenditure increases only by $10\%$. If he consumes 150 kg of pulse after the price has increased, then how much pulse was consumed by him initially?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Constant Product Ratio (CPR) ki ninja trick laga, Initial aur Final consumption ka seedha fraction nikal.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): CPR direct fraction. Mathematically :-
$$\frac{Initial}{Final} = \frac{100 + P\%}{100 + E\%} = \frac{132}{110} = \frac{6}{5}$$
$$5 \rightarrow 150 \Rightarrow 1 \rightarrow 30$$
$$6 \rightarrow 180$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Traditional formula. Mathematically :-
$$P_{new} = 1.32 P_{old}$$
$$E_{new} = 1.10 E_{old}$$
$$C_{new} = \frac{E_{new}}{P_{new}} = \frac{1.10}{1.32} C_{old} = \frac{5}{6} C_{old}$$
$$\frac{5}{6} C_{old} = 150 \Rightarrow C_{old} = 180$$

Exam Takeaway: Price aur Expenditure ke percentages diye hon toh formula me base swap karke consumption ka ratio instantly ban jata hai.

List IList II
Ratio Direct HackC1 / C2 = (100 + E2\%) / (100 + P2\%) doesn't hold. Right hack is Initial/Final = (100+New Price) / (100+New Exp).
